resources.string: Both switches start off. Disconnect before changing them, then reconnect. These are device-wide lab settings, separate from saved setups and profile reset. Test each separately; connectivity is not guaranteed.

Try a new UDP source port on handshake retries and during the session. WARP ingress also rotates destination ports 2408, 500, 1701 and 4500. A session hop without an authenticated reply rolls back; brief packet loss is possible.

Add variable zero padding inside encrypted IPv4/IPv6 data and verification probes, without changing IP length headers. Large packets, empty keepalives and handshake packets stay unchanged. Does not disguise the handshake.
Select WireGuard explicitly to edit these switches. Other selected transports leave them inactive.
